title: Alpha-GPT: Human-AI Interactive Alpha Mining for Quantitative Investment

task.value: Mining formulaic alphas (trading signals/factors) via human-AI interaction, using LLMs to translate researchers' trading ideas into alpha expressions and refine them.
task.quote: In this work, we propose a new alpha mining paradigm by introducing human-AI interaction, and a novel prompt engineering algorithmic framework to implement this paradigm by leveraging the power of large language models.

architecture.value: Agentic workflow of ideation (Trading Idea Polisher with database), implementation (Quant Developer LLM generates seed alphas, genetic programming enhances them), and review (Analyst agent with backtest engine); WebUI, AlphaBot LLM agent with RAG, algorithmic mining and acceleration layers.
architecture.quote: It is a multi-layered framework composed of a user-facing interface, a core LLM agent, an algorithmic mining engine, and a computation acceleration layer.

data.value: Intraday volume-price data of Chinese and US stocks: OHLCV, VWAP, and sector data; WorldQuant IQC platform with over 5,000 data fields.
data.quote: We use intraday volume-price data of Chinese and US stocks. The data include the basic candlestick chart data (OHLCV), volume-weighted average price (VWAP), and sector data.

window.value: WorldQuant IQC 2024 evaluated in real time during the official competition period; Stage 2 results by June 25th, 2024. No other dates for in-sample/out-of-sample splits given.
window.quote: Table 2: WorldQuant International Quant Championship 2024 Stage 2 Results (by June 25th, 2024)

models.value: Llama3 70B as chat model and BGE-M3 as embedding model; GPT-4 used as evaluator and simulated human user.
models.quote: We used Llama3 70B Grattafiori et al. (2024) as the chat model and BGE-M3 Chen et al. (2024) as the embedding model.

baselines.value: Junior human quant researchers (translation consistency); human leaderboards in a JoinQuant high-frequency alpha competition; worldwide and regional top participants in WorldQuant IQC 2024.
baselines.quote: Specifically, we incorporated self-improving mechanism Wang et al. (2024) to generate factors and compared the result with human leaderboards, as shown in Table 5.

headline_result.value: In WorldQuant IQC 2024 Stage 2, Alpha-GPT generated 81 qualified alphas, total score 48866, in-sample 65505, out-of-sample 43319, ranking top-10 worldwide among over 41000 teams.

leakage_controls.value: WorldQuant evaluation was conducted in real time during the official competition period to avoid future information leakage.
leakage_controls.quote: Importantly, our evaluation was conducted in real time during the official competition period, ensuring that no future information leakage occurred.

limitations.value: Machine learning alphas are not discussed; authors note human domain expertise and intuition often surpass current LLM capabilities.
limitations.quote: This approach is predicated on the recognition that human domain expertise and intuition in trading and investment often surpass the current capabilities of LLMs.
